title: LocalModuleEpiGermLift
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal F$ a module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U\subseteq X$ open, $A$ a module sheaf on $U$, and $f:A\to\mathcal F|_U$ an epimorphism [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For an open $x\in V\subseteq U$ and $s\in\mathcal F(V)$, there exist an open $x\in W\subseteq V$ and $t\in A(W)$ with $f_W(t)_x=s_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. No finite-generation assumption is needed and sectionwise surjectivity on V is not asserted.

source.place: Tag 01CP, lemma-stalk-internal-hom, third paragraph; finite-coordinate construction and its finite-type vanishing argument.

proof.text: Forget to abelian sheaves. The existing source-library colimit preservation instance sends f to an epimorphism. Mathlib Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' says its image sieve is covering.

Translate the covering on the localized site through mem_over_iff and overEquiv_iff. Choose a covering member W containing x and its preimage section t. The germ restriction formula gives the claimed equality.

proof_origin.note: Categorical expansion of the finite-coordinate argument by R3; full proof in declaration docstring.

mathlib_searches.query: A linear map on stalks composed with a finite free sheaf morphism lifts locally; an epimorphism of module sheaves lifts section germs
Epimorphisms of sheaves of modules are locally surjective on sections
mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi', PresheafOfModules.epi_iff_surjective and related results. These are used in the complete proof; no exact statement about localized module germs.
Existing germ representation/equality, free sheaf universal properties and covering sieve APIs; no combined finite free local lifting or shrinking statement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_module_epi_germ_lift
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F : Modules X) (x : X) (U : Opens X)
    (A : SheafOfModules.{u} (((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf).over U))
    (f : A ⟶ F.over U) [Epi f]
    (V : Opens X) (i : V ⟶ U) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : F.val.obj (op V)) :
    ∃ (W : Opens X) (hxW : x ∈ W) (j : W ⟶ V)
      (t : A.val.obj (op (Over.mk (j ≫ i)))),
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W x hxW
        (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (j ≫ i))) t) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf V x hxV s
